title: What If You Stood at the Bottom of the Deepest Hole Ever Drilled?

scenes.text: What if you stood at the bottom of the deepest hole ever drilled? It isn't what scientists expected.
Soviet scientists on the Kola Peninsula drilled down 12,262 meters, more than 12 kilometers.
Models predicted about 100 degrees Celsius down there. The rock was about 180, and the heat stopped the drill.
Between three and six kilometers down, they found water trapped in cracked rock.
They also found microscopic plankton fossils in rock over two billion years old.
It reached only about a third of the way through the crust there. Earth's center is thousands of kilometers deeper.

description:
What if you stood at the bottom of the deepest hole ever drilled?
The Kola borehole reached 12,262 meters, where the rock was about 180 degrees Celsius, far hotter than expected.
What should we run through next?
